brief: A simulated vintage sheet of paper fills the canvas. Text appears automatically and continuously, appearing as if typed by an invisible machine. As the stream of characters generates, the printed text causes visible physical distress to the paper surface. The paper warps, and fibers visibly fray and peel away from the freshly printed characters, giving the impression of accumulated, physical stress over the passage of time.

statement: This sketch simulates the physical stress of a vintage paper sheet under continuous typing. As text appears character by character, each printed letter causes visible warping and fiber fraying around its position. The effect is achieved through particle systems that simulate paper fibers peeling away from freshly typed characters, combined with subtle warping distortion applied to each character. The simulation uses a texture background to represent aged paper, and fracture patterns radiate outward from each new character, mimicking how physical stress accumulates over time on paper surfaces. The result is a continuous visual representation of paper aging under the mechanical pressure of text generation.
